title: Find your NHS number - NHS
content: Find your NHS number Use this service to get your NHS number. Your NHS number is a 10 digit number, like 485 777 3456. You do not need to know your NHS number to use NHS services, but it can be useful to have it. Information: You can also get your NHS number in your NHS account . Who can use this service You can use this service if you live in England. You can also use this service for someone else. Before you start You will need your: full name date of birth postcode of the address you've registered at a GP surgery with You will have your NHS number sent to you by text, email or letter. If you're using this service for someone else, enter their details. They will be sent their NHS number. Start now Other ways to get your NHS number If you cannot get your NHS number online you can: find it on any letter from the NHS like a prescription or appointment letter call your GP surgery and ask them for your number About using this service By using this service you are agreeing to our terms and conditions and privacy policy .
